thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: possible exfil via proxy-prod (INC-2026-042). Alerts: outbound connections to 54.23.12.200:443 with payloads containing partial Authorization headers. Suspect debug logging pushed sensitive headers. Triage starting.

Ravi: I'm oncall, looking. Which proxy host and timeframe?

Marta: seen from proxy-prod-3 and proxy-prod-4, ~12:03-12:20 UTC, ~180 POSTs to external collector. Logs show JSON payloads with headers included.

Ravi: confirmed. Sample lines: "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer sk_live_...redacted..." }.

Asha: ugh. Possible cause: recent debug-logger rollback included full header dump. I'm starting key rotation for svc-proxy-writer. ETA ~12m.

Marta: I'll apply temporary egress block for 54.23.12.200 on the proxy SGs, and capture pcap for those hosts.

ops-bot: applied egress block on sg-prod-proxy (rule id r-0a1b2c3d) to 54.23.12.200:443. pcap job queued (job id pcap-2161616161).

Ravi: Good. @security please join. We need a quick impact assessment and decide customer notification.

security: joining. Priorities: rotate tokens, preserve evidence, check S3 for forwarded logs, and check whether any customer PII was included.

Carla: I'll own customer comms if we need to notify. Do we have list of affected tenants? Marta?

Marta: quick query shows increased 401s for tenant_42 and tenant_77 around same timeframe; both have proxies using svc-proxy-writer. No broad outages yet.

Asha: rotation in progress: running `./rotate-service-key svc-proxy-writer --dest k8s` (running in ops runbook). Notifying consumer teams to update.

Ravi: snapshot logs to secure bucket before any scrub: `aws s3 cp /var/log/proxy/incs.json s3://incidents/2161616161/ --sse aws:kms` (done)

ops-bot: snapshot uploaded: s3://incidents/2161616161/snapshot-2026-04-21.json, task id snap-321.

legal: please preserve all chain of custody notes. We'll review regulatory disclosure obligations depending on PII.

Asha: rotation complete, new key published to k8s secret svc-proxy-writer-key-v2, proxies restarted via rolling restart. Restart logs show success.

Marta: monitoring: outbound attempts to 54.23.12.200 stopped, proxy error rates normalizing. I see tenant_42 401s dropped after restart.

Ravi: can we confirm consumers updated? Any services failing to authenticate now?

Asha: two internal consumers flagged; notified their owners via pager. They responded and pulled new key; auth restored.

Carla: drafting customer note: "We detected a configuration issue that briefly included sensitive headers in debug payloads to an external endpoint. We've rotated impacted keys and taken compensating actions. No sign of customer data exfiltration beyond header snippets; continuing investigation." Will share draft in #customer-notify for review.

security: initial assessment: likely limited to header fragments; we will run a targeted search across log sinks and downstream collectors for tokens and PII. Will create follow-up tickets: SEC-2161 (audit), SEC-2162 (logger config rule), SEC-2163 (token rotation sweep).

Marta: removing egress block after 15m hold and monitoring (ops-bot will remove).

ops-bot: egress block removed (rule r-0a1b2c3d).

Ravi: Post-incident actions (short list): 1) rotate all svc-proxy-* keys, 2) add alert for header-like patterns in outbound payloads, 3) revert any debug-logger changes in CI and enforce config gating, 4) update runbook for quicker token rotation.

Carla: timeline and draft comms will be ready in 45m. Legal asked to review before send.

legal: acknowledged, will review timeline and advise on disclosure threshold.

Asha: closing note: keys rotated, proxies restarted, pcap + snapshots uploaded, CS notified of two tenants with brief 401s. Keeping incident open for deeper audit and cleanup tasks.

Ravi: Thanks everyone. If we find expanded impact we'll re-escalate. Moving to post-incident review slot 2pm UTC tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned tickets: SEC-2161, SEC-2162, SEC-2163.
